# Vendored community text corpus

Plain-text captures of public Last Epoch community pages and official forum posts, fetched 2026-10-08 for personal offline reference. They back the citations in `knowledge/`, so those citations stay valid without network access.

- `INDEX.md` lists every file with its source URL. Each file also carries a header with SOURCE URL, FETCHED date, TITLE and NOTE.
- Content belongs to its respective authors and sites: Maxroll (Ziff Davis), Fandom contributors (CC-BY-SA), and Eleventh Hour Games (the in-game guide and official forum posts).
- Personal use only. Not for redistribution.
